items.text: We applied some fixes and improvements and the big new stuff is coming soon...
We're rolling out a small but important hotfix focused on controller input.
Controller Fixes

Fixed a controller button conflict: A single gamepad button was incorrectly assigned to two different actions — drinking an energy drink and placing all items on the table. Both actions now have separate, correct bindings on the controller.: Thanks for playing and for all your reports. You're helping us keep the tunnels clean and the escapes smooth. Stay sharp out there!
Today we're rolling out a small but important update that addresses the most commonly reported issues.
Fixes
Disappearing furniture fixed (again, but this time permanently)
We've reworked the system responsible for loading and maintaining furniture states. This fix should now be final, and the issue shouldn't return in future updates.
Gameplay Reminder
Stuck in a tunnel? Remember to crouch
Some tunnels are intentionally narrow. If you can't move forward, make sure you're crouching.
This update focuses on quality‑of‑life improvements and fixing several issues reported by the community.
Fixes & Improvements
Multiple QoL improvements to interactions, clarity, and overall gameplay flow.
Fixed various visual glitches including minor artifacts and incorrect rendering.
Reduced item spawn‑rate while digging so players don't acquire papers too quickly.
Improved guard behavior for more consistent patrols and reactions.
Fixed an issue where usable items were visible when collecting dirt piles.
Hey Prisoners,
We're really happy to see that the new chapter is getting such a positive response. Your feedback helps us track down issues faster and keep polishing the game.
Today's patch focuses on several fixes and quality‑of‑life improvements:
Fixes & Improvements
Fixed the disappearing coffee dispenser
It should no longer vanish after loading the game.
Players who already lost theirs should receive a refund so they can buy the dispenser again.
Improved colliders for cell doors and the carpet
Interactions should now feel more predictable and consistent.
The magnet is no longer visible while idle when using a high FOV.
This visual glitch has been resolved.
Lights should now properly restore after being turned off when you get caught
Restored the missing shelf in the final cell upgrade
It was disappearing, now it's back where it belongs.
Thanks again for all your reports and support. If you spot anything else, let us know. We're on it.
See you in the yard! 🗝️
Hello Inmates… and those planning to become inmates!

We've just rolled out a small update that cleans up a little "creative chaos" around the prison. Some of you noticed that a few decorations were still hanging around like that one inmate who refuses to leave the yard after lights-out. Don't worry. We've taken care of it.
What's new (and slightly ridiculous)
All temporary decorations have been removed. The prison is now 87% less festive and 100% more prison‑y.
We've installed a new system that automatically disables similar decorations in the future. No more surprise pumpkins in July or random holiday lights during an escape attempt.
We're cooking up brand‑new content behind the scenes. Can't say much yet, but let's just say… the guards are nervous.
Thanks for sticking with us and keeping the prison in shape. More updates are coming. They won't require a mop and bucket afterward.
🎄 Christmas Update – Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out 🎄
Greetings, Escapees!
As Christmas approaches, we want to send warm wishes to all of you digging your way to freedom. May your tunnels be sturdy, your plans clever, and your festive spirit unbroken!
Underground Item Spawning Revamp: We've reworked the system so that items appear in more varied and surprising ways, making each dig more exciting and unpredictable.
Improved Item Physics: Items now behave realistically once unearthed, adding immersion to your escape attempts.

Christmas Decorations: Even behind bars, it's Christmas Eve. You'll notice festive touches throughout the prison to remind you that the Christmas spirit can't be locked away. (Could be disabled in game menu.)

Minor Fixes & Tweaks: As always, we've squashed some bugs and polished gameplay to keep your escape smoother than ever.: Thank you for being part of our growing community. Stay crafty, stay festive, and keep digging!: Merry Christmas!
Good morning prisoners! Today's patch brings a fix for achievements. Should now work correctly in Challenge Modes and across all other modes too.
✔ Achievements now trigger properly in Challenge Modes
✔ Minor improvements across the game
Your clever tricks and daring runs will now be rewarded with achievement.

topNew: ✔ Achievements now trigger properly in Challenge Modes

items.text: Bed fix Hey Escapees!
We've got some fresh news straight from the prison yard. In this latest update, we tackled one of the most frustrating issues: the bed that was sinking players into the floor.
Thanks for your patience and support. Now you can finally get some rest… without waking up under the floor! 😉
New Time Trials & Collision Fixes!
Hey everyone,
Patch for Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out is live! Here's what's new:
Two new time-based challenges – In these special trials, every player starts fully upgraded. No grinding, no excuses – just pure escape skill. Can you beat the clock when everything's maxed out?
Improved collision detection – Fixed the issue where players could fall through the map. Digging is now safer and more reliable.
Minor bug fixes – We've addressed a few small issues to keep the game running smoothly.
Hey Prisoners, We’ve rolled out a new patch with some important fixes and small tweaks.
Unity Security Update - We’ve applied the latest Unity security patch. Yes, the one everyone’s been talking about.

Save Load Bug - We’ve fixed the issue where the in‑game clock could freeze at 5:00 (or other odd times) when loading a save. If you still experience problems with loading: Please wait up to 3 minutes – in some cases the game may just need more time.: If nothing happens, try verifying the integrity of your game files via Steam.
If the issue persists, contact us at support@digitalmelody.eu – together we’ll get it sorted out.
Other Small Fixes
Known Issues
Steam Deck + keyboard & mouse: there’s a problem with “continuous digging.” In this setup, you’ll need to click repeatedly instead of holding the button. We’re working on a fix.
Thanks for sticking with us and sharing your feedback – it helps us keep improving Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out.
See you in the tunnels!
Hey Escapees!
Control Remapping is here – the most requested feature is finally in the game. Most controls can now be customized to your liking.
Fixed the tunnel in Chapter 2 (Low End mode) that refused to collapse. No more immortal tunnels.
Plus a few smaller fixes to keep things smooth.

We know about the fridge that won't budge. That fix is coming in the next patch. We're also investigating other issues, so if you spot something strange, please send us details at support@digitalmelody.eu. Thanks for playing and keep digging!
Hey escape artists!

We’ve been tunneling through bugs and blasting through code to bring you a fresh batch of fixes and features. This update adds some long-awaited magic (and a bit of extra loading time) to your prison-breaking toolkit.

Cloud Save is live! Your progress now floats safely in the cloud. Switch devices, reinstall the game, or survive a power outage, your tunnel stays intact. Heads up: the game might take a bit longer to load and save. That’s the cost of syncing your escape plan with the sky.
Item spawn rebalanced in maximum security. Early tunnel stages were a bit too brutal. We’ve tweaked item spawns so you’re not stuck digging through dirt with a wooden stick and a dream.
Dynamite tweaks. Blowing up rocks underground finally works as expected. No more awkward fizzles, just glorious, dusty explosions.

Various minor fixes and tweaks. We squashed a few sneaky bugs, smoothed out some rough edges, and gave the game a little extra polish. You might not notice them all, but your escape should feel just a bit smoother.
Thanks for all your feedback and support. Keep digging, keep scheming, and remember: freedom is just one well-placed dynamite stick away.
If anything feels off, let us know at support@digitalmelody.eu or scream into the nearest vent. We’re listening.
Dear Runaways,
We've significantly optimized memory and resource usage to ensure the game runs smoothly and smoothly on low-end devices. This should also prevent any crashes.

Hey escape artists! We've been digging deep — not just tunnels, but into the code — to bring you a smoother, more reliable prison-breaking experience. This update tackles some pesky bugs and polishes up the gameplay.
Fixed an issue where save loading would freeze at 100%. No more staring at that last percent!
Resolved a bug causing loss of control over your character while crawling through tunnels.: Addressed a problem with buying food when your respect level was sky-high. Even legends need lunch.

Various minor fixes and stability improvements.: Thanks for all your feedback and support — keep digging, keep scheming, and remember: freedom is just one tunnel away.: If you experience any other problems, please let us know and we'll try to fix them quickly! Have fun and enjoy the soft sand!
The huge update you've been waiting for!
A brand new chapter and a continuation of our rebellious hero's adventure.
It's time to face new challenges in the High Security Prison update!
The new mode introduces a completely new, more secure prison ward, along with:
A much longer excavation and a challenging corridor system; without a compass, it's going to be tough
Boulders underground that can only be destroyed with dynamite
New, eccentric and charming characters
A guard who is sensitive to the noise of dynamite and will be more of a nuisance
New items and chests to find
A police chase and even more fun!
Improved save system - separate save slots for each chapter
New achievements in the new chapter
Performance optimizations and minor bug fixes

releases.displayName: August 11th - some new features you asked for

items.text: Hey escapees! We're back with a little appetizer before diving into work on Hardcore Mode. For now, here's what's on the menu:

Low End Mode: Available only in the settings from the main menu. We recommend enabling it only if digging causes noticeable lag when creating holes. Activating this mode create the "alternate tunnel", but switching back will restore the hole. Maybe someone will find an alternative use for it!
Inverted Y-Axis: You asked for it. Now it's here.
UI Scaling: Originally made for Steam Deck, but it might come in handy for others too.
Indicator above the teapot and coffee machine when they're ready to use.
Arrow key movement support: You can now control your character using the arrow keys. A little something for the left-handed players.
Improved item pickup near the metro tunnel.
More fixes coming soon, but for now, we're heading back to work on Hardcore Mode!

If the game was installed on a slow HDD, loading the scene that occurs after reaching the ladder in the tunnel could take a very long time. Some of you thought there was a crash or the game had frozen. We've fixed this issue, and now everyone can quickly use the ladder and continue their escape.
The ladder no longer requires a 3-minute wait. (Ladder crash/dark void/etc.)
Game size optimization (reduced to 9.2GB!)

Occasionally, a bug causes the next lunch time message to appear incorrectly after going to sleep. However, the daily cycle itself doesn't change. It's just a visual glitch. We're investigating the cause of this behavior.
Information about the first major update coming soon. Stay tuned!
More fixes are ready! We're working on further improvements and huge content update. Stay tuned!
Fixed input issue. Its should works as intended now. Even on Steamdeck with docked mode!
Rarity Color was added to the underground junk
Fixed bug with double "grab".

If you get stuck in the void after using the ladder just wait. This loading time can take 3 minutes, if you installed the game on 5400RPM HDD. Go take some tea this time. We will investigate this case to improve this. (edited)

First of all, thank you so much for playing and providing your valuable feedback. We've already started implementing some of the things you've been asking for, and we're starting with the first patch with minor fixes.
Finally, an important note about Steam Input. More fixes are on the way. Stay tuned!
You can now hold the button responsible for digging instead of clicking repeatedly.
Improved item pickup functionality near the tunnel descent.
Fixed save issues where interaction with items was impossible.
Updated languages.
Fixed several visual glitches.
Steam Input can cause keyboard input interruption. Workaround for now: Unplug your controller/steering wheel etc or disable Steam Input in game properties.
